sources.label: morphe patches by cesbar
sources.author: zPatches
patch_list: Block Didomi & Matomo tracking SDKs, hide consent prompts for 3rd party & geolocation data
Allows easy configuration of deeplinks (velov.cyclocity.fr, velov.grandlyon.com) required by the app to sign-in
Use a different Google Maps API key to fix modified apps
Hide the onboarding "Plan your journey" screen
Allows you to unlock a bike even if you're not near the station.
Spoofs the package signature required for Firebase, fixes notifications
Fix the login error "Access denied. This account is already in use on another device." by pretending to be the web client
